events.title: DISK-Y Free Demo Now Available — Joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: The free DISK-Y demo is now available! The free demo launched on Steam on October 19, 2026 at 11:00 UTC (20:00 JST), for Windows and macOS. Show the new student, 〈Yu〉, around the school DISK-Y is a minimal retro visual novel with elements of psychological horror, built around the idea of a game that fits on a single floppy disk. With 320×240 pixel art and FM synthesis music by NINOMIYA Yuji, an unsettling school tour awaits. Will you merge with her unstable mind, or reject her? The choice is you

events.title: Store page launched for *DISK-Y*, a PC-98-style minimalist retro visual novel.
events.summary: La pagina Steam è ora disponibile 👁️DISK-Y è una visual novel rétro minimalista in stile PC-98, attualmente in sviluppo.Accompagna Yu, una studentessa appena trasferita che sta affrontando alcuni problemi psicologici, nella sua nuova scuola e diventa per lei una presenza su cui poter contare.👇 Aggiungilo alla tua lista dei desideri 👇
